name: Eliezer
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Abram asked what the Lord would give him, seeing he went childless and the steward of his house, Eliezer of Damascus, stood to inherit everything.

note.label: Genesis 15: The Covenant and the Four Hundred Years
